caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical hat with a flat top and a slightly curved brim, resting on a plain, light beige background. The hat is predominantly painted in shades of dark green and teal. It is adorned with intricate floral and foliage patterns featuring yellow, light green, and orange elements, along with dark blue-black leaves and stems. The surface of the hat displays a symmetrical floral motif and some small yellow circular accents. The rim of the hat is decorated with a lighter, subtle floral or vine-like pattern that contrasts with the darker green base. There is a small, red handwritten signature in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Man's Hat Box
